proposals.action_title: Upload 50 High-Volume stickers on Redbubble using existing Literal Idioms templates
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble requires zero upfront cost, has built-in traffic, and stickers are low-friction impulse buys. Utilizing assets from 'produce_literal_idioms_v2' bypasses generation bottlenecks and targets humorous, searchable niches.
proposals.first_action_today: Download 10 completed png assets from GitHub Artifacts to Android phone and upload to Redbubble with optimized tags (funny literal idioms).

proposals.action_title: Launch the first Coloring Book on KDP using Runware PAYG (approx. 1 EUR cost)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The system needs its first live product. Runware is active in PAYG mode and can generate 40 high-quality coloring pages for less than 1 EUR. Amazon KDP has massive organic traffic for specific niches (e.g., 'Gothic Mandalas' or 'Steampunk Animals').
proposals.first_action_today: Run the 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline via GitHub Actions using Runware API key to compile the PDF.

proposals.action_title: List 5 Parametric 3D printing models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D has a highly active, niche-specific audience looking for functional or aesthetic STL files. Using 'produce_stl_parametric' outputs allows listing premium files (priced at 1.50 EUR to 2.99 EUR) with immediate organic visibility.
proposals.first_action_today: Create the Cults3D account and upload the first parametric STL file generated from the pipeline.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Gamedev Asset Packs on itch.io (Pay What You Want with €2.99 suggested price)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The gamedev community on itch.io frequently downloads asset packs. Using 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' allows compiling generated UI buttons, seamless textures, or 2D sprites into zip files. Setting a 'Pay What You Want' price lowers the barrier to entry while allowing tips.
proposals.first_action_today: Package existing assets from 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' into a clean ZIP file with a short markdown description.

proposals.action_title: Upload 5 Low-Content KDP Notebooks targeting hyper-specific micro-niches
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content books (lined journals, logbooks) are fast to generate. By targeting highly specific professional or hobby niches (e.g., 'Beekeeper Logbook' or 'Termux Cheat Sheet Journal'), you bypass high-competition keywords.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 5 covers using 'produce_kdp_cover' via the free Cloudflare Workers AI pipeline and compile with a standard 120-page lined interior PDF.
